'''Solicitor of Inheritorial Claims''' was a position and title used by [[House Mecetti]]. The Solicitor was responsible for maintaining and reading the last will and testaments of [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] to ensure the inheritance and hereditary claims were upheld.<ref name="BI">{{WEGCite|story=Blood Inheritance|book=Tapani Sector Instant Adventures}}</ref>
